title: Patient Payment Plans Term Schedule: Balance Bands and Entry Criteria
content:
Patient Financial Services publishes the term schedule below for **Patient Payment Plans**. Each of the six terms is an interest-free installment arrangement; the schedule fixes, term by term, how many monthly installments the term runs, the band of total invoice balance it accepts, its smallest regular installment and the entry criteria a patient must meet before that term is offered.

## Schedule A: balance bands and installment floor

| Term | Monthly installments | Smallest total balance to open (USD) | Largest balance carried (USD) | Smallest regular installment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 75.00 | 750.00 | 25.00 |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 6 | 150.00 | 1500.00 | 25.00 |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 9 | 300.00 | 2250.00 | 35.00 |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 12 | 500.00 | 3000.00 | 40.00 |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 18 | 1000.00 | 4500.00 | 55.00 |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 2000.00 | 7500.00 | 80.00 |

- **Monthly installments** is the number of monthly installments over which the term is amortized.
- **Smallest total balance to open** is the smallest total invoice balance that can open the term.
- **Largest balance carried** is the largest total balance the term may carry, both at enrollment and after invoices are added.
- **Smallest regular installment** is the lowest regular monthly installment the term allows; a balance whose computed installment comes out lower must take a shorter term.

## Schedule B: entry criteria

| Term | Months before the offer date with no plan default | Assistance case on file required | Youngest guarantor (whole years) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 12 | No | 18 |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 12 | No | 18 |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 24 | No | 18 |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 24 | No | 18 |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 24 | No | 18 |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 24 | Yes | 18 |

- **Months with no plan default** is the number of calendar months before the offer date during which the patient must have had no payment-plan default.
- **Assistance case on file required** states whether the patient must already have a case under the Patient Financial Assistance Program on file, in any status, before the term is offered.
- **Youngest guarantor** is the youngest age at which a person may sign a plan; a minor's balances are put on a parent's or guardian's plan.

## Schedule C: billing classes accepted

Every term accepts the same four invoice billing classes:

- Self-Pay Patient Invoice
- Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice
- Out-of-Network Balance Invoice
- Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice

A billing class not on this list is not accepted by any term of Patient Payment Plans.

## Reading the schedule

- **A 400.00 total (illustration only).** It lies inside the bands of the 3-Month, 6-Month and 9-Month terms and below the smallest opening balance of the 12-Month term (500.00).
- **Where the bands overlap**, a balance can fit several terms at once; the schedule itself does not rank them.
- **Band edges are inclusive**: a total of exactly 750.00 is within the 3-Month band, and a total of 750.01 is not.
